l0.text: Makes DigestIT source-available: free to use internally, but nobody may offer it as a competing hosted service.

bullets: Visitors to the repository now see what DigestIT is and a plain-language license summary.
Anyone may run DigestIT free of charge, including in production for internal use; offering it as competing SaaS is not allowed.
Each version becomes Apache 2.0 four years after release (first date: 2030-09-24).

items.change: new: BSL 1.1 text plus parameters (licensor, Additional Use Grant, Change Date, Change License).
new: one-paragraph pitch and a license summary that links to LICENSE.

annotations.note: Licensor and copyright holder: SJY-14; Licensed Work: DigestIT.
Additional Use Grant, the key clause: production and internal use are free; competing hosted/managed/"as-a-service" offerings are excluded.
Clarifies that giving your own employees and contractors access counts as internal use.
Change Date 2030-09-24 → the work converts to Apache 2.0 on that date.
Product pitch: multi-level explanations of diffs on a timeline dashboard.
Plain-language summary of the license; it restates the LICENSE parameters, so both files must change together.
